jobs.description:
Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly?

As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:30 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

jobs.occupation: KYC Analyst - Temp mission of 3 months - Brussels - M/F/X
jobs.description:
As a KYC Analyst you will play a key role in verifying and maintaining client information. This temporary role of 3 months requires a solid understanding of KYC processes and fluency in English.

Client Details

Our client is an international Fintech present in many countries around the world and having its HQ in Brussels.

Description

As a KYC Analyst your responsibilities are:

• Review and verify client documentation to ensure compliance with KYC requirements
• Maintain and update client records in line with regulatory standards
• Conduct due diligence on new and existing clients
• Identify and report any discrepancies or risks in client documentation
• Collaborate with internal teams to address compliance issues effectively
• Ensure timely and accurate completion of KYC processes
• Assist in audits and regulatory reviews as needed
• Stay updated on changes in KYC regulations and industry standards

A successful KYC Analyst should have:

• A first experience in KYC is necessary
• Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Please note that we are unable to sponsor work permits or visas. Therefore, applicants must already be legally authorized to work in Belgium at the time of application
• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
• Knowledge of banking and financial services regulations

jobs.occupation: Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian family-owned company with over 100 years of experience in the distribution of premium technical equipment for the agricultural sector, the green/landscaping sector, and material handling. It employees +100person, generates +150M€ of annual turnover and aims to strengthen its market position by focusing on leading-edge technology, strong partnerships with dealers, and efficient services in sales, marketing, after-sales, and financing.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Lead the commercial strategy: annual sales plan, margins, product mix

• Animate and guide the sales & marketing team (define priorities, coordinate & coach the team on the field) - you will be responsible of 3 areas sales manager, 3 product managers & 2 persons in the back office 

• Manage pricing strategy and negotiate with key accounts & dealer networks

• Develop business via demo machines, rental, and used equipment

• Be responsible of the company brand by owning all marketing & communication activities & ensuring their consistency: marketing materials, digital channels, campaigns, ... 
• Handle the implementation of a new CRM system
• Strengthen communication with the dealer network: newsletters, events, information sessions

• Oversee events & trade fairs: stand concept, logistics, demos, post-event analysis

• Act as main link between manufacturer & internal teams; track KPIs, market trends, bonuses

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following profile:

• +5 years experiences as B2B sales leader with strong commercial development skills & ability to negotiate with wholesalers 
• Experiences with long selling cycle & technical products (agriculture, machinery, industry)
• Previous experience in people management or team coaching 
• Background or strong affinity with the agriculture sector is a plus 
• Solid experience in operational marketing 
• Comfortable in managing projects (CRM, reporting, process optimization)
• Strategical mindset coupled with the willingness to remain operational & available for the teams 
• Personal traits: entrepreneurial mindset, structured, responsible, clear communicator, low ego. 
• Languages: Fluent in French, Dutch & English

The hiring organization is a respected entity focused on consumer advocacy and policy development. As a medium-sized organization, it is committed to addressing consumer needs through research, policy work, and collaboration with stakeholders.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Analyze and assess consumer policies with a focus on economic perspectives.
• Develop and implement strategies for effective advocacy at the European and international levels.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to advance consumer interests.
• Monitor policy developments and identify opportunities to influence decision-making processes.
• Prepare reports, briefings, and presentations to support policy positions.
• Represent the organization in meetings, events, and consultations with policymakers and other stakeholders.
• Provide expertise on economic aspects of consumer protection and market practices.
• Contribute to the overall objectives of the Marketing & Agency department.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• A Master's degree in Economics or Business Studies.
• Strong experience in European or international policy and advocacy.
• Proficiency in assessing consumer policy areas, particularly from an economic perspective.
• Excellent communication and analytical skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
• A proactive and results-oriented approach to work.
• Excellent level of English both written and verbal, French and Dutch is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Animal Health Sales Director - Veterinary - Pharma
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian company specialising in the development, registration, marketing and commercialisation of veterinary pharmaceutical products for both livestock and companion animal. The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: 

Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.
• Assess partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers and negotiate exclusive distribution opportunities.
• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.
• Prepare and support product launches in collaboration with the sales team.

Field Sales Management 

• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for the Belgian market.
• Lead, motivate, and coach a team of 5 sales representatives covering Belgium.
• Maintain close contact with key stakeholders in the Belgian veterinary market.
• Monitor market trends, competition, and business performance.

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following profile:

• Veterinary degree or equivalent in-depth expertise and network within the veterinary industry.
• 10/15 years of experiences in the Animal Health industry.
• Strong knowledge of the Belgian veterinary market and its key stakeholders.
• Proven experience in a commercial, sales management, or business development role.
• Previous experience managing and coaching sales teams.
• Strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good level of English.

FMCG

Jobomschrijving

• Create and maintain production plans
• Ensure products are available for customer orders and stock
• Monitor production constraints daily and adjust schedules when needed
• Support projects related to new product launches, phase-outs, and process improvements
• Work with different teams to coordinate product launches and discontinuations
• Represent the planning team in internal meetings
• Keep planning data and systems up to date
• Communicate with planning, production, purchasing, and customer service teams to solve planning challenges

• Great communication skills in Dutch, English and French
• Related bachelor or master 
• Stress resistant and assertive
• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus
• Good SAP knowledge

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

Available to join the team rapidly.

jobs.occupation: Multilingual Customer Advisor – DE/EN/(NL or FR) in Liège
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service and fluent in multiple languages? As a Customer Advisor in our Liège-based team, you’ll be the first point of contact for customers, ensuring their needs are met with professionalism and efficiency. You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

You will support Satellic customers through different communication channels and provide professional, efficient assistance regarding their requests and issues: handling calls, emails, and chats related to the road toll for freight vehicles in Belgium and, in the future, other projects such as Monizze, Arrive, Fain and verification of on-board documents via the CRM system.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Upper secondary education completed

• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in customer service or a related field

• Full-time availability

jobs.occupation: Operations Coordinator - Dutch & German speaking m/f/d (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

• Order processing, either manual or via an internal platform
• Maintain various master data (customers, prices, materials, ...) in SAP in order to ensure data accuracy and streamline processes to keep the data up to date
• Address customer concerns by executing root cause investigations and offering solutions (replacements, corrective invoices, ...)
• Issue credit/debit memos
• Support inventory management activities

• You're fluent in English and intermediate to proficient in either Russian, French or Arab
• You have a first experience in a similar role
• Upper secondary diploma/high school diploma

In this key role, you will ensure the accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, maintain compliance with accounting and tax regulations and drive continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities :

• Lead, coach, and develop the Accounts Payable team.
• Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable process, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
• Coordinate invoice processing, payment runs, and AP-related financial controls.
• Manage monthly closing activities, reconciliations, accruals, and follow-up of outstanding items.
• Ensure compliance with VAT, tax, and internal accounting policies.
• Act as the main point of contact for AP-related matters across multiple stakeholders.
• Identify and implement process improvements, standardization initiatives, and automation opportunities.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent through experience.
• Several years of experience in Accounts Payable within a multinational or complex organization.
• Strong SAP knowledge; experience with SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Solid understanding of VAT and accounting regulations.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Analytical, structured, and detail-oriented.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
• Interest in process optimization, automation, and digital finance solutions.

Looking for a new challenge in supply chain within an international and forward-thinking organization?

As a Supply Chain Assistant you will support the supply chain team with daily tasks such as:

• Manage material availability and inventory levels to ensure uninterrupted operations. 
• Maintain SAP MRP parameters and follow up on shortages, replenishmen, and planning activities. 
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering and Operations teams to resolve material-related issues. 
• Analyze KPIs and SAP reports to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
• Support process improvement and optimization initiatives for critical materials and supply chain workflows.

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
